messages:
james_acme: Hi — after yesterday's canary rollout our assistant stopped honoring an important system instruction in long conversations. We tell it 'always list sources' in the system prompt, but after ~6 user turns it no longer includes sources in answers. This started right after the 2026-03-15 canary. It's a regression for us and blocks a release.

alice_support: Sorry about that — thanks for reporting. Can you paste a minimal repro (session excerpt + request_id) and the model/version you hit? Any response IDs or timestamps help. We'll escalate as soon as we have them.

james_acme: Repro payload below (sanitized):
```json
{
  "model": "redwood-v2-large",
  "messages": [
    {"role":"system","content":"You are an assistant. ALWAYS list sources used when answering, in a 'Sources:' section."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Start a long conversation, ask clarifying Qs, then answer with sources."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Turn 1..."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Turn 2..."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Turn 3..."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Turn 4..."},
    {"role":"user","content":"Turn 5 final question: summarize and include sources."}
  ]
}
```
Request id: req_0a1b2c3d. Session id: sess-77. Model header we used: redwood-v2-large, and the canary tag we saw in responses was canary-2026-03-15. Happened consistently (~4/5 runs).

alice_support: Thanks — escalating to eng. @sanjay_eng @laila_prod can you take a look? Also pinging deploy bot for canary metadata.

deploy-bot: Deploy r-2026-03-15 started 2026-03-15T22:10Z. Changes: attention-kernel v2, KV-cache tuning enabled, quantize-profile=B. Rollout: 15% traffic. No other config flips.

sanjay_eng: On it — can you DM us the full raw request/response (headers + body) for req_0a1b2c3d? Also confirm whether you saw any 429/500 or unusual latency on those calls.

james_acme: Sent full dump to @alice_support DM (includes req_0a1b2c3d, sess-77). No HTTP errors — calls were 200 but final text omitted the 'Sources' block. Latency was normal (~240ms). Happened across 3 different client IPs.

eva_research: This smells like a KV-prefix eviction or prefix-length mismatch after the attention kernel change — system prompt may be getting evicted from the KV cache earlier than before. Can you attach token counts for those sessions? Also, please try pinning to the pre-canary model snapshot v2-2026-03-01 to see if behavior differs.

laila_prod: @james_acme if you can try header X-Model-Version: v2-2026-03-01 and report back that helps us isolate canary vs config. If pre-canary preserves sources then we'll consider pausing/rolling back canary.

james_acme: Tried the pinned header now. With v2-2026-03-01 the assistant includes the Sources section even for 10+ turns. So regression correlates with the canary. Happy to keep traffic pinched to older variant for our workspace.

sanjay_eng: Thanks — creating internal ticket INF-4321. Immediate plan: (1) reproduce locally with the exact payload (2) run KV retention stress test for long prefixes (3) snapshot kernel traces for req_0a1b2c3d and compare pre/post canary (attention kernel + KV). If repro is confirmed we'll either roll back the attention-kernel or adjust KV retention thresholds. ETA ~4 hours for initial triage.

alice_support: Triage noted and customer updated. We'll follow up once eng has a fix or rollback decision. Thanks for fast repro steps and the request dump, @james_acme. :thumbsup:
